entities.title: Batched file loading
entities.summary: Whether search and outline load files through io_uring (Linux) or POSIX AIO (macOS), plain reads, or whichever proves faster.
entities.validation: Only the exact values always and never change anything; every other value, and no value, means auto.
entities.details: Read once, the first time a batch of files is loaded, and kept for the life of the process. always uses the batched loader whenever the platform has a usable one (falling back to plain reads where io_uring is unavailable); never always reads one file at a time; auto times both (see decisions.json, batch-io-by-timing).
